''See also: [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Ragnarus, also known as the [[Crimson Vault]], is an ancient [[Territory]] and [[Incarnation]] that serves as a repository for immensely powerful weapons. Access to the Vault is restricted by bloodline; only the royal kings of [[Damasca]] possess the ability to open its [[Gates]]. These weapons are characterized by their immense strength and devastating potential, but they always demand a significant toll from the user. This cost can manifest as rapid physical aging or the requirement of blood sacrifices. To maintain a seal on the [[Incarnations]], specific trees connected to Ragnarus must be nourished through regular sacrifices. Individuals capable of navigating or utilizing the power of this [[Territory]] are known as [[Ragnarus Traveler|Ragnarus Travelers]]. While these travelers gain extraordinary abilities, they must be willing to pay the associated prices. The Vault is also home to various native creatures and artifacts, some of which can be captured and integrated into other locations like [[Valinhall]]. The essence of Ragnarus is often described as being driven by a [[hunger]] for power and sacrifice.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|As one of the original nine Territories, Ragnarus is a location characterized by its ruby light, torches, and silver doors marked with the visage of a one-eyed, bearded king. This territory, which maintains a direct route into the royal palace of [[Cana]] and is one of the four [[Incarnations]] identified by [[Indirial]], promotes sacrifice and possesses a sticky, grasping presence similar to a disembodied heart. While it is known for containing powerful weapons and swords, the artifacts found within come with a price, including a sword named Ragnarus that bit [[Kai|Master Kai]]. During her appointment, [[Leah]] traveled to the territory where Ragnarus witnessed her oath and provided her materialized crown. The bloodline of Ragnarus must remain in power, and the entity's history is even reflected in the [[Hanging Tree]], which was once a tree from Ragnarus.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Ragnarus the [[Crimson Vault]] is a straightforward [[Territory]] of overt violence and instant gratification that reigns over all other Territories. This entity possesses an armory of glittering, thirsty weapons and various tools that can be used as weaponry, including a poison that leaves marks on bodies. Within its antechamber sits a carved wooden throne, and the entity's power can be harvested to fuel its arsenal. While Ragnarus once fought [[Elysia]], it later crippled [[Kai]] and was identified by the red, pulsing metal heart pulled from its [[Incarnation]], [[Zakareth]]. Though [[Leah]] is the last remaining child of Ragnarus and can summon the entity using her crown, others have interacted with its legacy through artifacts like [[Simon's mask]] or [[Kai]]'s red-and-black blade.}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|“How about a sword from Ragnarus?” Simon asked.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c20" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|“Your brother’s sword has quite the bite,” he said. Indirial winced. “Ragnarus. Well, don’t worry about it.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c21" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|“That’s four,” he said. “Endross, Ornheim, Naraka…and Ragnarus.”<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c23" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|“Whatever it is, it’s almost certainly from Ragnarus,” Grandmaster Lirial concluded.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c23" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|“Ah, Ragnarus,” the Incarnation said with a sigh. “Territory of overt violence and instant gratification.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c19" />}}
